input.summary: Add Licensee termination for convenience on 30 days' notice with pro-rata refund; confirm Licensor has no convenience right during the Initial Period
input.comment: [Playbook] The 36-month Initial Period gives us no way out absent Licensor breach, so we have added a convenience exit on thirty (30) days' notice with a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees and confirmed the Licensor has no reciprocal at-will right mid-term. If helpful, we can move to 60-90 days' notice with an early-termination fee capped at three months' fees.

ops.text: IV Termination for Convenience. Licensee may terminate this Agreement for convenience, in whole or in part, at any time upon thirty (30) days' prior written notice to Licensor, without penalty, early-termination charge or other liability, in which case Licensor shall refund to Licensee any prepaid fees covering the period after the effective date of termination on a pro-rata basis. Licensor shall have no right to terminate this Agreement for convenience or without cause during the Initial Period or any extension thereof.
